newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico 97 auto sales could rise up to 30 pct - AMIA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico 97 auto sales could rise up to 30 pct - AMIA.

text.p: Mexican auto sales -- exports and domestic sales -- could jump by up to 30 percent in 1997, from a record 1.21 million units sold in 1996, the Mexican Auto Industry Association (AMIA) said Monday.

"We think there will be an increase from 25 to 30 percent in sales," AMIA director general Fausto Cuevas Mesa told Reuters. Exports could rise between 10 and 15 percent, compared with 970,874 units in 1996, he added.
Cuevas Mesa said 80 percent of Mexico auto production is for exports, with 85 to 87 percent sent to the United States and Canada.
